volume_source_type: numeric source string parsed losslessly to float for analysis
volume_units: provider-reported volume units; repository does not establish a more specific unit
price_volume_alignment: same immutable source row and timestamp
missing_policy: Missing required Volume is unavailable, not zero; no fabrication, interpolation, or forward fill.
zero_policy: Exact source zero is preserved as observed activity. Ratio normalization yields zero when baseline>0; log-relative is unavailable for zero numerator.
extreme_policy: Preserve every data_valid finite Volume regardless of magnitude; no clipping or winsorization.

time_of_day_support.premarket_and_afterhours_limitation: Extended sessions use coarse minute semantics; time-of-day is descriptive only and not a normalization candidate.
